candidate_pin_authority: development_data provenance and selected raw review; no fit trajectory reread

scope.selection: complete pre-existing consumed geometry inventory; no outcome-based selection or symmetry reduction
scope.deduplication: Exact Cartesian coordinates, atom order/types/bonds, parameter bytes and all active key tokens; comments/whitespace and only polar-print/save-uinduce are ignored. Signed fields are separate cached targets, not extra zero-field exports.
scope.instrumentation: Only RESPONSE-MATRIX-EXPORT reporting keyword may be appended; reviewed source/binary and actual parity are future root-owned gates.
scope.pending: A, Ed, Ep and independent u/v arrays require new instrumented calls; old .uind is a baseline u target, not proof of separate v or a stored operator.
scope.calls: 54 prospective instrumented analyze EM calls, first1+remaining53; two snapshots per call are not separate native invocations. Any fresh uninstrumented parity call is additional and owned by the scout protocol.
scope.ions: Kept as controls. Proposed oxygen-only correction vanishes on bare ions; cached zero-field ion energies/moments need no candidate reevaluation.
scope.forces: A fixed-coordinate operator does not provide coordinate derivatives; original force gates cannot be certified from these exports alone.
scope.reserved: All reserved/held and earlier orientation-validation fixtures excluded exactly as frozen target inventory. No new loss, thresholds, fit or molecular execution.
